svg.title: Thus the entire original stack source, including harmonic coordinates, is recovered. The identity jp acts on the retained section; it need not be the identity on unused redundant directions. Equiv- alently, keeping physical output rows Uap yields Gram form p∗p. Every roll equation recovers by the same intermediate section cancellations and the same real-slice adjoints. The positive exten- sion Q 7→Q + rd∗ 3d3 preserves its curvature contraction under recovery since d3d2 = 0; its full physical three-form lower bound and root are recovered as in the preceding constructions. Fourier normalizations are evaluated before this transport, retaining each coarse/fine volume factor and each installed toll. Consequently the assembled horizon retains its stationary equations, terminal normalization, crossings and donated fine differences, with the original widths and prices in the transported physical norms.
